duration.$description: Animation and transition durations. The user motion axis (data-motion on <html>) re-points this whole ladder via the resolver's motion modifier — reduced shortens every rung, off zeroes them — so compliance is structural: recipes reference the rungs and never gate themselves.

signature.$description: The signature-moment rung (design language: 500ms+): the written-live wordmark, hero choreography — ceremonial edges only, never workflow feedback.

easing.$description: Easing curves. settle/travel are the register pair (the Engraved Ledger motion voice: decisive start, soft landing, no overshoot — nothing bounces); standard/decelerate/accelerate are the general-purpose trio.

settle.$description: Entrances and user-triggered changes: the authoritative snap-then-settle (strong ease-out).

travel.$description: On-screen movement between two visible positions (strong ease-in-out).
